gaps.explanation: All p5 fund columns are in detail (General schedule pp15-16, nonmajor combining statement, and the Economic Development / Debt Service / Street and Sidewalk Maintenance columns added in pass 1). The remaining 29,441 is the General Fund 'Bond issuance costs and fees' 29,441, which the p5 statement prints among General expenditures (General Total expenditures 9,410,913), while the p16 General Fund Schedule of Revenues, Expenditures, and Changes in Fund Balance prints TOTAL EXPENDITURES 9,381,472 and the same money as 'Bond issuance costs (29,441)' under OTHER FINANCING SOURCES (USES); it is in detail as that other-financing line (-29,441, p16). 9,381,472 + 29,441 = 9,410,913. Same money, printed in a different section; adding it as an expenditure would count it twice and moving it would relabel a printed line. No fix.
